name: school_announcement_push_queue
sql:
CREATE TABLE school_announcement_push_queue (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  announcement_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  link TEXT,
  scheduled_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  sent_at TEXT,
  failed_at TEXT,
  attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  delivery_cursor TEXT,
  sent_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  failed_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  skipped_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_error TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
, lease_expires_at TEXT, next_retry_at TEXT)

name: school_announcements
sql:
CREATE TABLE school_announcements (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  title_search TEXT NOT NULL,
  link TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  date TEXT,
  is_new INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_new IN (0, 1)),
  created_at TEXT,
  is_hidden INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_hidden IN (0, 1))
, updated_at TEXT, department TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', department_search TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', is_highlighted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(is_highlighted IN (0,1)), is_deleted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(is_deleted IN (0,1)), source_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'crawler' CHECK(source_kind IN ('crawler','manual')), admin_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, content_overridden INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(content_overridden IN (0,1)), crawler_title_search TEXT)

name: announcement_id_high_watermark
announcement_metadata_delete
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER announcement_metadata_delete AFTER DELETE ON school_announcements BEGIN
 UPDATE sync_metadata SET source_row_count=source_row_count-1,
 visible_row_count=visible_row_count-(OLD.is_hidden=0),
 synced_at=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') WHERE resource='school_announcements';
END

name: announcement_metadata_insert
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER announcement_metadata_insert AFTER INSERT ON school_announcements BEGIN
 UPDATE sync_metadata SET source_row_count=source_row_count+1,
 visible_row_count=visible_row_count+(NEW.is_hidden=0),
 source_max_created_at=MAX(COALESCE(source_max_created_at,''),COALESCE(NEW.created_at,'')),
 synced_at=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') WHERE resource='school_announcements';
END

name: announcement_metadata_visibility
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER announcement_metadata_visibility AFTER UPDATE OF is_hidden ON school_announcements
WHEN OLD.is_hidden IS NOT NEW.is_hidden BEGIN
 UPDATE sync_metadata SET visible_row_count=visible_row_count+(NEW.is_hidden=0)-(OLD.is_hidden=0),
 synced_at=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') WHERE resource='school_announcements';
END

name: school_announcements_capture_source_title
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER school_announcements_capture_source_title AFTER UPDATE OF title ON school_announcements
WHEN OLD.source_kind='crawler' AND NEW.admin_revision!=OLD.admin_revision
 AND NEW.title IS NOT OLD.title AND OLD.crawler_title_search IS NULL
BEGIN UPDATE school_announcements SET crawler_title_search=OLD.title_search WHERE id=NEW.id; END

name: school_announcements_content_owner
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER school_announcements_content_owner BEFORE UPDATE OF title,title_search,date ON school_announcements
WHEN (OLD.content_overridden=1 OR OLD.source_kind='manual') AND NEW.admin_revision=OLD.admin_revision
BEGIN
 UPDATE school_announcements SET crawler_title_search=NEW.title_search
 WHERE id=OLD.id AND crawler_title_search IS NOT NEW.title_search;
 SELECT RAISE(IGNORE);
END

name: school_announcements_crawler_identity
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER school_announcements_crawler_identity BEFORE UPDATE OF link ON school_announcements
WHEN OLD.source_kind='crawler' AND NEW.link IS NOT OLD.link
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'crawler_source_url_is_immutable'); END

name: school_announcements_crawler_revision
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER school_announcements_crawler_revision AFTER UPDATE OF title,title_search,date ON school_announcements
WHEN NEW.admin_revision=OLD.admin_revision AND
 (NEW.title IS NOT OLD.title OR NEW.title_search IS NOT OLD.title_search OR NEW.date IS NOT OLD.date)
BEGIN UPDATE school_announcements SET admin_revision=admin_revision+1 WHERE id=NEW.id; END

name: school_announcements_deleted_insert
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER school_announcements_deleted_insert BEFORE INSERT ON school_announcements
WHEN NEW.is_deleted=1 AND NEW.is_hidden!=1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'deleted_announcement_must_be_hidden'); END

name: school_announcements_deleted_visibility
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER school_announcements_deleted_visibility BEFORE UPDATE ON school_announcements
WHEN NEW.is_deleted=1 AND NEW.is_hidden!=1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'deleted_announcement_must_be_hidden'); END

name: school_announcements_hide_push
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER school_announcements_hide_push AFTER UPDATE OF is_hidden ON school_announcements
WHEN NEW.is_hidden=1 AND OLD.is_hidden!=1
BEGIN
 UPDATE school_announcement_push_queue
 SET failed_at=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),last_error='ANNOUNCEMENT_HIDDEN'
 WHERE announcement_id=NEW.id AND sent_at IS NULL AND failed_at IS NULL;
END

name: school_announcements_source_title_dedupe
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER school_announcements_source_title_dedupe BEFORE INSERT ON school_announcements
WHEN NEW.source_kind='crawler' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM school_announcements WHERE crawler_title_search=NEW.title_search)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(IGNORE); END
